verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that an API key from the incident.io dashboard is needed to call the API. Nothing documents scoping, per-key permissions, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The trust-and-safety pages describe Investigations staying 'within the bounds you set', which is a different feature and not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
